content.user_title: Create Rap Songs, Beats, and Short Videos
content.value_statement: A rough idea or loose verse can be difficult to turn into a rap track. Prepare lyrics and briefs, then use AI Rap Maker to generate tracks, beats, or short videos.
actual_capabilities: Turn a song idea into a brief with a narrator, a scene, and a mood.
Prepare supplied lyrics with verse and hook labels while preserving the original wording.
Set the style, mood, and energy for a rap track or an instrumental without vocals.
Use the site's draft export when audio is not requested.
Prepare a short audio excerpt and performer photos for a video template or Song to video mode.
Check track and video jobs on the site and identify completed results available for download.
limitations: Media generation requires access to the external AI Rap Maker site. This skill does not generate audio or video locally.
The song interface accepts up to 3,000 characters for ideas and 5,000 for supplied lyrics.
You handle sign-in and confirm any credit spend or checkout. The site shows the current quote.
Video inputs require permission to use the audio and photos of consenting adults.

use_cases.title: Draft a Rap From a Scene
use_cases.description: Turn a rough story into a brief or a verse and hook for a writing session.

use_cases.title: Set Up an Instrumental Beat
use_cases.description: Choose a style, mood, and energy for a beat without vocals.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Short Rap Video
use_cases.description: Pair an authorized track excerpt with photos of consenting adult performers.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Verse and Hook
prompt_templates.prompt: Write one verse and one hook about closing a bakery before sunrise. Use a focused mood and keep the result in chat.
prompt_templates.scenario: Start with a text-only writing request.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Beat Without Vocals
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare an instrumental Boom Bap setup with a calm mood and balanced energy. Return the settings without opening the site.
prompt_templates.scenario: Choose settings for an instrumental draft.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Track From My Lyrics
prompt_templates.prompt: Keep my pasted lyrics unchanged and select Melodic Rap. Show what you will send and wait for my approval before entering it on AI Rap Maker. Ask me to approve any cost before submitting.
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare a track from an existing lyric draft.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Song-to-Video Clip
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a short Song to video clip using my saved track and approved performer photos. Check the required photo count and show me the quote. Wait for my approval before uploading or submitting.
prompt_templates.scenario: Coordinate audio, photos, permissions, and a site quote for a video.

output_examples.input: Prepare a rap brief about leaving a bakery before sunrise. Keep it in chat.
output_examples.output: Narrator: A baker at the end of an overnight shift. Scene: Flour on their sleeves as they wait at an empty bus stop. Mood: Tired but proud. Style: Boom Bap.

output_examples.input: Plan a calm Boom Bap instrumental with balanced energy. Do not open the site.
output: Status: Settings prepared. No audio generated.

best_practices: Specify the narrator, a concrete scene, and the mood you want.
Review the exact inputs before sharing them with the site. Check the current quote before approving a charge.
Check Your tracks or Your videos for an existing job before retrying.
anti_patterns: Submitting private lyrics or personal details without approval.
Using performer photos without consent or audio without permission.
Reporting a generated file before the site shows a completed result.

faq.question: Can I start with an idea instead of finished lyrics?
faq.answer: Yes. Use An idea for a brief of up to 3,000 characters. Use My lyrics for existing lyrics of up to 5,000 characters.

faq.question: Will the skill change my lyrics?
faq.answer: It preserves your wording unless you ask for changes. It can add verse and hook labels where useful.

faq.question: Can I make a beat without vocals?
faq.answer: Yes. Select Instrumental only, no vocals, then choose the style, mood, and energy.

faq.question: Do I need to sign in or pay?
faq.answer: You handle any sign-in. Check the current quote and approve any credit spend or checkout before submission.

faq.question: What do I need for a short rap video?
faq.answer: Prepare a short audio excerpt you have permission to use. Provide the number of photos requested by the selected mode, using consenting adult performers.

faq.question: What happens if browsing or generation is unavailable?
faq.answer: The skill returns the prepared inputs, the matching site link, and the last verified status. It does not claim a file was generated.
